About.metaDescription: Learn about Eren Teknik Engineering's founding story, mission, vision, and engineering philosophy.
About.heroSubtitle: Adding value to industrial infrastructure since the 1960s.
About.storyP1: Eren Teknik, founded in the 1960s, combines nearly half a century of experience with modern engineering approaches to develop qualified infrastructure and superstructure solutions.
About.storyP2: Specializing particularly in clean room engineering, all processes in mechanical and electrical disciplines are managed under a single roof with full integration. GMP and FDA standards, which are at the center of the activities, are meticulously observed; sterile field projects requiring high precision are successfully implemented.
About.storyP3: Quickly adapting to the increasing need for automation systems with the new dynamics brought by developing technology, Eren Teknik has carried its engineering capacity in this field to global standards with the strategic solution partnership it signed with Siemens. As a requirement of its integrated project management vision, the company incorporated the construction discipline over time; thus, it achieved a comprehensive engineering structure capable of managing all mechanical, electrical, automation, and construction processes from a single source.
About.storyP4: Adopting the principles of sustainable quality and 'optimum solution', Eren Teknik supports its century-old knowledge and trust building in the sector not only with technology but also with its own expert staff. By transferring its corporate memory to new generations with the strength it draws from its roots, it continues to be the source of knowledge and trust in the engineering sector.
About.missionText: To maximize the operational efficiency of our business partners through our integrated approach that unites different engineering disciplines under one roof; and to bring every project to life in accordance with high-quality standards, adhering strictly to budget and timeline plans.
About.visionText: To be a pioneering brand that implements innovative technologies in the engineering sector. To become a reliable and internationally sought-after solution partner that not only meets standards but also sets the industry's quality benchmarks.

lowVoltage.title: Low Voltage Installations
lowVoltage.description: Design, installation, and commissioning of sub-1000V power distribution systems in industrial and commercial facilities. Including panel design, cabling, and protection systems.

mediumVoltage.title: Medium Voltage Systems
mediumVoltage.description: Design and implementation of 1-36 kV medium voltage switchgear, transformer stations, and distribution systems. Full compliance with national grid standards.

lighting.title: Lighting Design
lighting.description: Interior and exterior lighting design, energy-efficient LED solutions, emergency lighting systems, and lighting automation integration.

grounding.title: Grounding & Lightning Protection
grounding.description: Ground resistance measurements, grounding grid design, lightning protection systems (LPS), and surge protection solutions.

energyEfficiency.title: Energy Efficiency Consulting
energyEfficiency.description: Energy audits, power quality analysis, compensation systems, and planning and implementation of energy saving projects.

automation.metaDescription: From PLC programming to SCADA systems, industrial automation and smart building control solutions.
automation.heroSubtitle: Smart control systems that digitalize and optimize your industrial processes.

plc.title: PLC Programming & Integration
plc.description: Programming, configuration, and integration of Siemens, ABB, Schneider, and Allen-Bradley PLC systems. Expert team in Ladder, FBD, and SCL languages.

scada.title: SCADA Systems
scada.description: Design, installation, and commissioning of centralized monitoring and control systems. Real-time data acquisition, alarm management, and reporting infrastructure.

bms.title: Building Management Systems (BMS)
bms.description: Smart building management systems for unified control of HVAC, lighting, access control, and energy management from a single platform.

energyMonitoring.title: Energy Monitoring Automation
energyMonitoring.description: Smart energy management and reporting systems that monitor facility energy consumption in real-time, detect loss/leakage points, and maximize energy efficiency.

processControl.title: Process Control Systems
processControl.description: DCS and hybrid control systems, instrumentation, process optimization, and advanced control algorithms.

mechanical.metaDescription: From HVAC systems to fire safety, industrial and commercial mechanical installation solutions.
mechanical.heroSubtitle: Mechanical installation solutions delivering comfort, safety, and efficiency together.

hvac.title: HVAC Systems
hvac.description: Design, installation, and maintenance of heating, cooling, ventilation, and air conditioning systems. VRF, chiller, and central system solutions.

fire.title: Fire Detection & Suppression
fire.description: Design and implementation of fire detection, alarm, and suppression systems. Sprinkler, FM-200, CO₂, and foam suppression systems.

plumbing.title: Plumbing Systems
plumbing.description: Design of clean water, waste water, and stormwater systems. Pump stations, pre-treatment preparation, and plumbing infrastructure.

gas.title: Natural Gas Installation

compressedAir.title: Compressed Air Systems

steel.title: Steel Structures
steel.description: Prefabricated steel structures, steel roof systems, mezzanine floors, and industrial steel construction projects. Calculation, detail, and fabrication drawings.

infrastructure.title: Infrastructure Projects
infrastructure.description: Road, sewage, water supply, drainage systems, and site development projects. Infrastructure solutions for organized industrial zones and industrial sites.

industrial.title: Industrial Facility Construction

management.title: Project Management
management.description: Construction project planning, scheduling, budgeting, and site coordination. Progress tracking, quality control, and occupational safety management.

modular.title: Modular and Prefabricated Building Solutions
modular.description: Portable and flexible prefabricated structures offering fast deployment capabilities for industrial facilities.

cleanroom.metaDescription: GMP-compliant clean room design, HVAC validation, and particle control systems.
cleanroom.heroSubtitle: GMP-standard clean room solutions for pharmaceutical, electronics, and food industries.

cleanRoomDesign.title: Clean Room Design & Engineering
cleanRoomDesign.description: ISO 14644-compliant clean room classification, architectural design, material selection, and detailed engineering. All cleanliness classes from Class 1 to Class 9.

hvacValidation.title: HVAC Validation (DQ/IQ/OQ/PQ)
hvacValidation.description: Design, installation, operational, and performance qualification of clean room HVAC systems. HEPA filter integrity testing and airflow pattern analysis.

particleMonitoring.title: Particle Monitoring Systems
particleMonitoring.description: Continuous particle counting systems, environmental monitoring, data logging, and alarm management. FDA 21 CFR Part 11 compliant software solutions.

gmpCompliance.title: GMP Compliance Consulting
gmpCompliance.description: EU GMP Annex 1, FDA, and PIC/S guideline compliance assessment. Validation master plan preparation and audit support.

pressureDifferential.title: Pressure Differential Control Systems
pressureDifferential.description: Clean room cascade pressurization design, pressure differential monitoring and control systems. Cross-contamination prevention strategies.
